## Change

Explain the problem and resulting change. List the affected module or documents.

## Traceability

- Task board card / issue:
- Requirement, user story or design item:

## Validation

State the checks actually performed, their results and evidence links. If a check
was not run or is not applicable, say so and explain why.

## Review

- [ ] The change meets the task's acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Related documents, diagrams and project scope agree.
- [ ] Useful teammate content, citations and editable sources are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets or identifiable participant data are included.
- [ ] Relevant setup notes and evidence links are included.
- [ ] A teammate other than the author has reviewed the change.

## Limitations or decisions

Record unresolved questions, planned checks and any action needed before merging.
